title: John Ramirez says everyone is waiting for Elizondo to talk about hybrids

tellings.quote: And then you've got John Ramirez, who in 2022 uh made comments to the effect that everyone is waiting for Lue Elizondo to talk about hybrids.

plain: In 2022, a former intelligence officer named John Ramirez said, more or less, that everyone is waiting for Luis Elizondo to talk about hybrids, meaning beings that are part human and part something else. Elizondo is a former official linked to a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports. A researcher named Jason Simosa repeats Ramirez's remark to Michels, as a hint that insiders know about such beings and that Elizondo might one day say so.
